description: This file defines the Bytes utility class for byte conversions, including parsing byte sizes, validation, and constraint validation, within the Drupal framework.

classes.name: Bytes
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for byte size conversions, validation, and constraint validation.

methods.name: toNumber
methods.description: Converts a size string with optional units to a float representing the number of bytes.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates if a string is a proper representation of a byte size.

methods.name: validateConstraint
methods.description: Validates a value as a byte size within a validation context, used with Symfony Validator constraints.
